title: Fisherfolk from Kasimedu harbour go on indefinite strike

ai.summary: Fisherfolk from Kasimedu have gone on an indefinite strike demanding Tamil Nadu government bring back eight boats seized by Andhra Pradesh and increase solatium for Cyclone Murasu victims.

facts.claim: Fisherfolk from Kasimedu have gone on an indefinite strike
facts.quote: Fisherfolk from Kasimedu have gone on an indefinite strike demanding that the Tamil Nadu government take steps to bring back eight boats that have been seized by the Andhra Pradesh government.

facts.claim: demanding that the Tamil Nadu government take steps to bring back eight boats that have been seized by the Andhra Pradesh government
facts.quote: demanding that the Tamil Nadu government take steps to bring back eight boats that have been seized by the Andhra Pradesh government

facts.claim: increase solatium for Cyclone Murasu victims
facts.quote: increase the amount of solatium paid to the kin of fishermen who died in Cyclone Murasu and to the owner of the boat that sank on that fateful day

ai.background_note: Fisherfolk from Kasimedu have gone on an indefinite strike demanding Tamil Nadu government bring back eight boats seized by Andhra Pradesh and increase solatium for Cyclone Murasu victims.
